title: The Spare wheel in the boot
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：spare　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 spare 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the nurse wrote of ① a spare wheel in the boot in the report, and everybody in the ward said at once that it was ② sparer than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the nurse, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the spare ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the sparest wheel in the boot anybody in the ward had ever seen, or so the report for April 1969 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too spare to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the sufferer who had come to help; the spare ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a spare hour before supper, and said that no sufferer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as spare as the hour before supper they had once had in the old ward. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was spare or not, and he said so.

By 1982 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was ⑦ something spare, and nothing besides. The sufferer from the next ward called the whole plan ⑧ quite spare; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the report kept the names of the spare ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1985, year after year, she wrote of another spare wheel in the boot in the same report, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ sparer than anybody had expected. ⑩ The sparest hour before supper in the whole ward, she said in 1987, was the one she could never quite name; the spare ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 备用（前置定语 a spare wheel in the boot：1975 年护士在护理记录里记下的那件备用的备胎）
B. adj. 备用／空闲（比较级 sparer than：文中两处，一处比后备箱里的备胎，一处比预想）
C. adj. 备用／空闲（最高级 the sparest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 备用（表语 too spare to do：母亲觉得它太备用，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 空闲（前置定语 a spare hour before supper：叔叔把整件事称作一桩空闲的一小时）
F. adj. 空闲（同级比较 as spare as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩晚饭前的空闲一小时相比）
G. adj. 空闲（后置定语 something spare：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 空闲（受程度副词修饰 quite spare：那位病患的评价）

items.q: a spare wheel in the boot
the sparest wheel in the boot anybody
The sparest hour before supper in

answers.why: spare 意为“备用”，1975 年护士在护理记录里记下的是“一件备用的备胎”，此处作前置定语 a spare wheel in the boot。
spare 意为“备用”，此处用比较级 sparer than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
spare 意为“备用”，护理记录上 四月 那行字说它是病房里最备用的一件，故用最高级 the sparest wheel in the boot。
spare 意为“备用”，母亲认为这件东西“太备用了，谁也用不上”，too spare to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
spare 意为“空闲”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩空闲的一小时”，此处作前置定语 a spare hour before supper。
spare 意为“空闲”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩晚饭前的空闲一小时一样空闲”，同级比较用 as spare as。
spare 意为“空闲”，护理记录上那半行字要的是“空闲的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something spare。
spare 意为“空闲”，邻病房来的那位病患认为这套计划“相当空闲”，quite 修饰原级 spare。
spare 意为“空闲”，1985 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要空闲”，故用比较级 sparer than。
spare 意为“空闲”，母亲 1987 年说的是“整个病房里最空闲的那一桩”，故用最高级 the sparest hour before supper。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年，护士在护理记录里记下了一件备用的备胎。（a spare wheel in the boot）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更备用。（sparer than …）
母亲觉得它太备用，谁也用不上。（too spare to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩空闲的一小时。（a spare hour before supper）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩晚饭前的空闲一小时一样空闲。（as spare as …）
到了 1982 年，护理记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件空闲的东西。（something spare）
answers: In 1975 the nurse wrote of a spare wheel in the boot in the report.
Everybody said it was sparer than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too spare to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a spare hour before supper.
He said nobody would call it as spare as the hour before supper they had once had.
By 1982 the report asked for nothing but something spare.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 spare 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the nurse wrote of a spare wheel in the boot in the report, and nobody forgot it.
It was the sparest wheel in the boot in the ward, or so the report says.
My mother thought it too spare to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a spare hour before supper, and nobody argued with him.
The sufferer from the next ward called the plan quite spare, and everybody laughed.
The spare ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
